title: context-budget-warn fires at 200k denominator on 1M-window models (false 'past context')
description: The UserPromptSubmit context-budget hook computes pct = loaded/window. It cannot detect a 1M context window from the transcript: model is recorded as 'claude-opus-4-7' (no [1m] suffix) and the 'context-1m' beta marker is absent. So windowTokens() defaults to 200000 and the 60% nudge fires at ~120k tokens = only 12% of the real 1M window. Fix: persist Claude Code's authoritative context_window.context_window_size + used_percentage from statusline.js, and have the hook consume that instead of the unreliable transcript heuristic.
notes: Root cause: 1M window undetectable from transcript; windowTokens defaulted to 200k so 60% nudge fired at 12% of real window. Fix verified in source (statusline persists authoritative size; hook consumes it). Not yet deployed (needs 2.1.5 release + statusline copy refresh).

title: Context-budget hook: warn/nudge to /compact at a configurable % (default 60)

De-dupe per session by tier (60/75/90) so it fires once per tier, not every prompt. Cannot force /compact (no hook can), but injects guidance + user-visible warning. Remove the dead CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE from settings.

title: qmd embed backlog (1091 pending) not draining despite cp-8xq runner
description: QMD status reports 1091 docs pending embedding (vector search partially stale). The cp-8xq fix shipped (commit 36025d7): scripts/qmd-embed-runner.js runs detached on Stop with a 6h throttle + single-flight lock, stamping STAMP_FILE only on success. Despite this the backlog is not clearing. INVESTIGATE: (1) is the lockfile ~/.cache/qmd/.braynee-qmd-reindex.lock stale/stuck blocking embed acquire? (2) STAMP_FILE ~/.cache/qmd/.braynee-qmd-embed.stamp — when did embed last succeed? (3) does findQmdJs() resolve the global @tobilu/qmd CLI, or exit 0 silently? (4) does 'qmd embed' succeed when run manually, or fail/timeout (15min ceiling)? (5) is the 6h throttle gating it out before it ever drains a large backlog? Root cause unknown until checked — do not guess.
notes:
ROOT CAUSE confirmed: embed is NOT failing. Stamp shows last embed succeeded 15:04 (clean exit). Throttle=6h so next embed gated until 21:04; pending grew to 1107 in the meantime. scheduleEmbed() in hooks/lib/qmd-reindex.js (lines ~110-128) gates ONLY on the 6h time throttle (since<interval) — the cp-8xq design specced 'run if >=N pending OR >=X hours' but the >=N-pending half was NEVER implemented. So a large backlog inside the 6h window cannot trigger an early embed. FIX: add a pending-count threshold to scheduleEmbed (query qmd status pending; if >= THRESHOLD, bypass time throttle, single-flight lock still prevents overlap). Secondary: stale lock found (pid 19964 op=update, process dead) — a qmd update crashed mid-run leaving the lock; steal-if-dead reclaims it but indicates ungraceful exits. Immediate remediation: run qmd embed manually to drain 1107.
FIX IMPLEMENTED: hooks/lib/qmd-reindex.js — added DEFAULT_EMBED_PENDING_THRESHOLD=200 (env BRAYNEE_QMD_EMBED_PENDING_THRESHOLD), pendingEmbedCount(qmdWrapper) parses 'Pending: N' from qmd status (fail-open=null), and scheduleEmbed(qmdWrapper) now bypasses the 6h time throttle when pending>=threshold. Single-flight lock unchanged (no overlap risk). Callers updated to pass QMD_WRAPPER: hooks/session-export-qmd.js + hooks/plan-capture.js. Validated: node -c clean on all 4 files; functional test parsed live pending=1064 and correctly returned scheduled=false when below threshold (no spurious spawn). Immediate remediation: manual qmd embed draining the backlog now (1107->1064 and falling). Stale lock removed.
EMBED PASS 1 result: drained 1107->628 pending (+1611 vectors) in 32min, but hit an UPSTREAM qmd/node-llama-cpp bug: LlamaContext disposed mid-run (DisposedError: Object is disposed) -> 'Session expired — skipping remaining chunks', 113 chunks failed. So qmd embed CANNOT fully drain a >1100-doc backlog in one invocation; the model GPU context dies partway. NOT a braynee bug. The threshold fix accommodates it: a fresh qmd embed process per trigger + partial drains leaving pending>threshold(200) -> re-triggers on next Stop -> converges over multiple passes rather than one. Note: runner's spawnSync 15min timeout is shorter than the ~32min disposal point, so via the runner embed is killed first (no stamp -> retries next Stop) — also converges. Running pass 2 manually to drain remaining 628.
close_reason: Fixed + committed on fix/qmd-embed-and-session-summaries (fa53c59, e703b56). cp-5aq: embed pending-count trigger; backlog drained 1107->28. cp-z0c: throttled auto-summary sweep with since-hours + min-age guard; 3 sophon sessions recovered.

title: REQUIRED: eliminate ~/code projects-root assumption from PRD subsystem (schema + scripts)
description:
REQUIRED (user directive: zero ~/code assumptions anywhere — hundreds of users
have no ~/code, so any such logic is a guaranteed failure). This is the LAST
remaining ~/code assumption after the PR #12 hook sweep. Promoted P3 -> P1.

## Root cause is DESIGN-LEVEL, not just 3 scripts

The PRD subsystem's data model itself hardcodes ~/code as the PRD<->repo join:

- skills/prd/SKILL.md:43  -> `folder: <slug>   # MUST match ~/code/<slug>/ — the join key`
- skills/prd/SKILL.md:125 -> "Build -> in `~/code/<slug>/` ..."
- docs/prd-authoring.md:16,29-31 -> "## The folder field is the join key /
  The PRD's `folder:` value MUST equal the directory name under `~/code/`."

Every consumer inherits this schema assumption:

- skills/prd/scripts/prd-new.mjs:194 -> prints "Folder join key: <folder> -> ~/code/<folder>/"
- scripts/prd-seed.mjs:17,114 -> CODE_DIR=path.join(os.homedir(),'code'); repoDir=path.join(CODE_DIR, fm.folder)
- scripts/prd-audit.mjs:9,24,101,102 -> CODE_DIR; fs.existsSync(path.join(CODE_DIR, fm.folder)); "not found at ~/code/<folder>" warning
- scripts/beads-dashboard.js:16,52,57,60,61 -> CODE_DIR=process.env.BEADS_CODE_DIR||path.join(HOME,'code'); enumerates CODE_DIR/* for .beads (already has a PARTIAL env override — the pattern to generalize)

This is NOT a context-gate problem (lib/is-code-context.js correctly does NOT
apply — there is no cwd to detect; these resolve a NAMED folder / enumerate a
directory). It is a configurable-projects-root problem.

## Required fix scope (do NOT implement yet — see Design notes)

1. Configurable projects root: introduce a shared BRAINY_PROJECTS_DIR
   (env + brainy setting), generalizing the existing BEADS_CODE_DIR override
   already in beads-dashboard.js, with a sane default and discovery. Consumed
   by prd-audit.mjs, prd-seed.mjs, scripts/beads-dashboard.js (and
   prd-new.mjs's printed guidance).
2. De-hardcode the PRD SCHEMA + skill/docs so the PRD<->repo join is defined
   abstractly (folder = the project repo dir under the configured projects
   root), NOT literally `~/code/<slug>`: update skills/prd/SKILL.md (lines 43,
   125), docs/prd-authoring.md (16, 29-31), and prd-new.mjs:194 wording.
3. Tests: verify the PRD<->repo join (prd-audit folder-exists check, prd-seed
   repoDir resolution, beads-dashboard project enumeration) works correctly
   with a projects root that is NOT ~/code, on a machine with no ~/code at all.

Also brings the previously-flagged settings-viewer/scripts/data/beads.mjs:25
(join(homedir(),'code')) + panels/beads.mjs:17 (user-facing "under ~/code"
string) under the same configurable-root fix.

References: supersedes the earlier P3 framing; sibling of cp-wp2 (hook sweep,
done) and R-1/cp-jt8 (git as required dependency). NOT the same class as
cp-d9g (session-auto-track transcript-dir ENCODING bug).
design: OWN FOCUSED PR — NOT folded into PR #12 (hooks). Do NOT start coding until the user explicitly approves the cp-qr9 plan (team lead will relay). The schema/docs change (item 2) is the riskiest part — it alters the PRD<->repo join contract, so it needs the test matrix (item 3) green for a non-~/code root before any merge. Suggested env/setting name: BRAINY_PROJECTS_DIR, generalizing BEADS_CODE_DIR (already in beads-dashboard.js:16). Keep ~/code only as the DEFAULT when nothing is configured (back-compat), never as a hard assumption.

title: brainy: ensure-obsidian.js spawn leaves Windows zombie processes
description: ensure-obsidian.js calls spawn(exe, [], { detached: true, stdio: 'ignore' }).unref() on Windows. Confirmed live: 5 Obsidian processes running, 1 with visible window (PID 32600 from 09:46), 1 orphan zombie (PID 3660 from 14:59 — when this Claude Code session started). Windows routes user taskbar clicks to the most recent process, which is the windowless zombie — clicks silently fail. Fix: on Windows use execSync('start "" "<exe>"') which delegates to the Windows shell and handles single-instance correctly. Test by killing existing zombies, running the hook, and verifying only one process remains.

References: R-1, cp-jt8 (git as required setup dependency). Track only; do NOT fix in PR #12 — separate non-blocking follow-up.

description:

Hook can't reconnect the MCP link (impossible) but CAN keep the server process alive; CC's HTTP transport then auto-reconnects to it.

BENEFITS: persistent model = no per-query cold start; HTTP transport = CC auto-reconnect; async hook = auto-start without a Windows startup task.
TRADEOFF: ~0.5GB standing RAM (acceptable vs the full 3GB; machine is 16GB and hit swap during heavy embed today).
